close-share.label: Share of IPL results that were close
close-share.filters: ≤ 10 runs, ≤ 6 balls to spare, or super over; 2008–2026
close-share.query: WITH r AS ( SELECT m.match_id, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, m.date, m.winner_id, m.team1_id, m.team2_id, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 1 THEN i.batting_team_id END) bat1, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 1 THEN i.runs END) r1, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 2 THEN i.runs END) r2, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 2 THEN i.total_legal_balls END) b2, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) super_over FROM matches m JOIN innings i ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.match_id) SELECT *, CASE WHEN super_over = 1 THEN 1 WHEN winner_id = bat1 AND r1 - r2 <= 10 THEN 1 WHEN winner_id <> bat1 AND b2 >= 114 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_close FROM r
